title: Google News MCP Server for AI Agents
description: RSS MCP server (Apify Standby mode) exposing Google News search as a live tool call for AI agents -- search any keyword or browse a topic section, in any language, straight from Google's own RSS. Returns headline, publisher, time, link and who else covered the story. Flat fee per call, no start fee.
seoTitle: Google News MCP Server, News Search Tool for AI Agents
seoDescription: MCP server for news search: an AI-agent tool that queries Google News live by keyword or topic section. Flat per-call pricing, no API key, no start fee, no browser. A Google News tool for AI agents.

tool-call.eventDescription: Flat fee for one search_news MCP tool call that returned at least one article, however many articles it returned. No result, no charge: a search with zero matches, a call rejected for a bad or missing argument, and a call where Google News itself did not answer are all free.
